workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The approved Beat Plan has multiple beats, but the movement can be realized as one structured artifact unless a medium plan accepts cumulative expansion.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

story_structure.name: Save The Cat Beat Sheet
story_structure.core_movement: A stable custodial night is disturbed by a fading painting, tested through the guard's hope that attention might save it, broken by the realization that care cannot restore the loss, and resolved in a final changed state where the painting is gone but the room is seen more deeply.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The beat sheet compresses into five Beat Plan beats: opening image/setup/catalyst, debate/break into new world, promise/midpoint, bad pressure/loss point/new synthesis, and final movement/final image beat.
story_structure.turn_logic: The story first appears to ask whether the guard can preserve the painting, then turns toward whether attention can dignify loss without reversing it.
story_structure.compression_rule: Combine opening image beat, setup, theme pressure, and catalyst into the first beat; combine debate and break into new world into the second; merge promise of premise with midpoint; let bad pressure, loss point, and synthesis share the penultimate beat; close with final movement and final image beat together.
story_structure.expansion_rule: If expanded, split the night into repeated tests of attention, a sharper midpoint false hope, a distinct low point when restoration fails, and a final public consequence after dawn.
failure_modes: the beat sheet becomes visible machinery rather than pressure arising from attention and loss
the midpoint treats attention as a magical repair mechanism
the low point over-explains the fading instead of preserving mystery
the final image beat consoles by restoring the painting instead of transferring attention

beats.one_move_summary: The guard notices the small painting fading during routine night watch.
beats.before_state: The guard treats the museum as a place to protect through routine.
beats.after_state: Routine custody is disturbed by a loss that appears only under neglect.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A damaged painting suggests a repair problem or security incident.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The painting fades most when no one gives it attention.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The problem moves from material preservation to moral attention.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Professional calm is crossed by private dread.

beats.intended_feeling: quiet alarm at noticing loss too late
beats.emotional_payload: Attention begins as a duty and becomes a burden.

tension_profile.emotional_function: starts with procedural control and exposes its limits

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence

source_evidence: The reference opens with a guard discovering a fading painting during routine work.

beats.one_move_summary: He hesitates between protocol and staying with the painting, then chooses witness.

beats.after_state: He commits his own attention to the loss.

expectation_turn.surprise_function: The first major choice makes care personal instead of institutional.

beats.intended_feeling: the vulnerable seriousness of choosing to witness

tension_profile.name: Control / Surrender

traceability_notes.note: The beat protects the meaning that attention matters as care, not control.

beats.one_move_summary: His attention slows or dignifies the fading, creating false hope that care might save it.

beats.after_state: He understands attention may only dignify the loss.
beats.value_shift: Hope of repair becomes unstable promise.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: If attention caused the fading to slow, sustained attention should reverse it.

expectation_turn.surprise_function: The midpoint reframes success from rescue to witness.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Helplessness deepens care rather than cancelling it.

beats.intended_feeling: grief sharpened by the refusal to look away
beats.emotional_payload: The work turns on accepting that care may not prevent loss.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Move from procedural control to surrendered witness while making each adjacent beat intensify or reframe attention.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: A lower adjacent shift can be waived only if the artist explicitly wants a more static vigil and the reviewer confirms the midpoint reframe still lands.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: The pressure shifts from noticing loss to choosing responsibility for it.
The guard's chosen witness stops feeling like rescue and becomes grief-bearing attention.
The false hope that attention can save the painting collapses into the low point of witness without rescue.
The unresolved loss moves from one person's vigil into a public change in perception.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the Save The Cat beat sheet reads as external plot mechanics rather than escalating attention pressure, or if the climax restores the image instead of changing perception.

arc_summary.beginning: A routine guard notices a painting fading when neglected.
arc_summary.turn: He learns that attention cannot restore the image but can change the meaning of the loss.
arc_summary.ending_or_residue: The painting remains gone, while the empty frame teaches the room to look harder.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: An arc is appropriate because the project needs setup, commitment, midpoint reframe, and climax/residue to prove that attention matters without solving the loss.

traceability_summary.note: The Beat Plan adapts the invented reference's fading painting, guard choice, and changed visitor attention.
The adapted Save The Cat beat sheet preserves attention as care rather than control.
